finalText:
All done. Every leftover use of the old call, `db.query`, is now switched to the new one, `db.execute({ sql, params })`. That covers 11 files across the analytics, orders, billing, support, catalog, and accounts packages.

One file still uses `db.query`: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. It's a vendored copy of another package, marked "do not edit, replaced wholesale on every upgrade." I left it alone on purpose.
